_comment: The WebView origin for the Android app is composed from server.hostname and
server.androidScheme in capacitor.config.json. That origin is what partitions
localStorage, which is where the game's saves live.
Changing either value silently gives every existing player a brand new, empty
save -- the old data is still on disk but nothing will ever read it again.
That is unrecoverable for users, so the values below are locked.
scripts/verify_storage_origin.js fails the build if they drift.
Only change them if you are prepared to invalidate existing saves, in which
case set DOL_ALLOW_ORIGIN_CHANGE=1 for that build to acknowledge it.
_lockedReason: initial Capacitor migration; must match the origin the first release shipped with
